description: Per-candidate backfill rows for #52 (track #50). Giannoulias announced 2026-08-02 and his campaign site (alexiforchi.com) has NO issues/platform page — only About / News / Contact / Volunteer — so unlike the phase-1 candidates there is no first-person platform page to seed from. Rows are launch-day press instead, both inside the 2016-01-01 recency cutoff. Two rows on purpose: WTTW is a known-good direct-RSS outlet, CBS is the one confirmed to carry first-person housing quotes, and a two-row file exercises the partial-failure path (a dead row must not discard the other row's extraction).

rows.title: Backed by Trade Unions, Alexi Giannoulias Launches Campaign for Chicago Mayor
Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias announces campaign for Chicago mayor
